conditions.ci.yml/ci-gate: Always runs (if: always()) after every other ci.yml job and aggregates their results through scripts/cigate.ts (P3-352): verify and scope must succeed, the scope-gated jobs may be skipped, anything else is red. It is the single status context the main branch protection should require (P3-350) and the one name the pilot readiness poll can key on.
conditions.ci.yml/verify-win: Runs when the scope job's desktop OR portable-suite output is true (P2-317): the portable Windows battery also exercises apps/daemon and apps/relay path logic, so a PR touching those runs it too, while docs-only or media-only changes never do.
